DXDTIME DEPLOYMENT NOTES
-------------------------

Code Path:
/var/www/vhosts/dxdtime.ddsolutions.io

Service:
/etc/systemd/system/gunicorn_dxtime.service

==========================
Deployment Comparison
==========================

1. CODE LOCATION
- Team said: cd /home/ddsolutions-www-dxdtime/htdocs/www.dxdtime.ddsolutions.io/
- We did: cd /var/www/vhosts/dxdtime.ddsolutions.io
- Reason: Actual code is hosted here

2. VIRTUAL ENV
- Team said: source venv/bin/activate
- We did: Skipped this
- Reason: systemd service already handles virtualenv

3. START DJANGO DEV SERVER
- Team said: python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
- We did: Skipped this
- Reason: We use Gunicorn, not Django dev server

4. GUNICORN RELOAD VS RESTART
- Team said: sudo systemctl reload gunicorn_dxtime
- We did: sudo systemctl restart gunicorn_dxtime
- Reason: reload doesn't apply code changes; restart is needed

5. CODE UPDATE METHOD
- Team tried: move old, place new (failed)
- We did: overwrite old with new
- Reason: service is stateful — full replacement broke app

==========================
Other Notes
==========================
- Plesk file manager failed with read-only error — use SSH
- No need to run: daemon-reexec, daemon-reload, enable/start nginx
- Always restart Gunicorn after code updates

Command:
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn_dxtime



This is not a good approach, if we want to run the application in production environment.,
DEPLOYMENT SUMMARY (STANDARD VS CURRENT)

| Component | Current | Industry Best Practice |
|------------------|--------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| Deployment | Manual SSH upload | CI/CD pipeline with Docker builds |
| Runtime | Gunicorn via systemd | Gunicorn in Docker/Kubernetes |
| Reverse Proxy | Plesk / unclear | NGINX with SSL, gzip, caching |
| Environment | venv (via systemd) | poetry/venv inside Docker/Independent VM |
| Static Files | In same code path | CDN or separate collected volume |
| TLS/SSL | Possibly manual via Plesk | Cloud/Loadbalancer or Nginx |
| Monitoring | Not configured | APM via newrelic/datadog |
| Logging | Possibly none or local files | Centralized structured logging |
| Secrets | Hardcoded/env in code | Vault, .env, or Docker Secrets |
| Rollback | Manual recovery | Versioned Docker images with Git rollback |
